fichas.title: Sound Insulation, Sound Absorption, and Protection from External Noise
fichas.summary: Guidance on reducing noise from building services, including plumbing fixtures, pipework, filling and emptying sounds, heating boilers, and ventilation ducts. Sound absorption reduces reflected sound rather than sound transmitted through building components or direct sound. External-noise protection uses building layout, insulated construction and openings, blinds, and landscaping. Illustrations show pipe clips, a boiler foundation, metal/rubber elements, duct silencers, room sound absorption, and sound reduction by open-air obstructions.
spaces: Rooms containing ventilation and air-conditioning ducts
uses: Reduce plumbing fixture and pipework noise
Isolate boilers and service connections from structure
Reduce sound transmission through ventilation ducts
Reduce reflected sound and reverberation in rooms
Protect occupied rooms from external noise
